## Description
Briefly describe the intent of this change and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / optimization

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and `.editorconfig` of this project.
- [ ] I have executed the automated tests (`backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest`) and all 53+ tests pass.
- [ ] I have verified the frontend build (`npm run lint` and `npm run build` in `frontend/`).
- [ ] I have not committed any sensitive information, keys, or real customer documents.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation where appropriate.
